basic_details.job_title: DIAT Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: The Defence Institute of Advanced Technology (DIAT), Girinagar, Pune - 411 025, will hold a walk-in interview on 4 December 2026 at 1100 Hrs for one Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post. The post is on the DRDO-sponsored project "Futuristic W Alloys and Composites" in the Dept of Metallurgical and Materials Engineering. The monthly stipend is 42,000/- + 30% HRA, and the upper age limit is 32 years.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is "not to exceed 32 years". The crucial date for determining the upper age limit is 4 December 2026. | Category Relaxation SC/ST, Women and PwBD Up to 05 years OBC (NCL) Up to 03 years | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: B.E./B.Tech/M.Sc. in Material Science/Materials Engg./Mechanical Engg./Metallurgy/Aeronautical Engg. or equivalent in First Division with NET/GATE; OR M.E./M.Tech in the same disciplines or equivalent in First Division both at Graduate and Post graduate level.

qualification.details: A minimum of 02 years of research experience is mandatory. | The upper age limit is "not to exceed 32 years". The crucial date for determining the upper age limit is 4 December 2026. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

salary_details.details: The position is temporary for a period of 09 months (OR) co-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier. The monthly stipend is 42,000/- + 30% HRA per month. In addition to the monthly stipend, medical facilities limited to MI Room facilities shall be extended to the incumbent. Recruited Fellows shall be encouraged to register for a Ph.D. at this institute through proper channels as per DIAT norms.

important_instructions: No TA will be paid for attending the Walk-in-Interview. The offer does not confer any right for absorption in DIAT, Pune. The offer may be terminated at any time on one month's notice. For further details, contact Dr. Shanmugasundaram T., PI, Dept. of Metallurgical and Materials Engg, on Telephone No. (020) 2460 4480, 85 / Mobile No. +91 7378317145.

faq.question: Q1. When is the DIAT SRF walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 4 December 2026 at 1100 Hrs at the Institute, Girinagar, Pune.

faq.question: Q2. How many Senior Research Fellow posts are there?
faq.answer: There is 01 Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post, on the DRDO-sponsored project "Futuristic W Alloys and Composites".

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the DIAT SRF post?
faq.answer: B.E./B.Tech/M.Sc. in Material Science/Materials Engg./Mechanical Engg./Metallurgy/Aeronautical Engg. or equivalent in First Division with NET/GATE, OR M.E./M.Tech in the same disciplines or equivalent in First Division both at Graduate and Post graduate level. A minimum of 02 years of research experience is mandatory.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the DIAT SRF post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is not to exceed 32 years as on 4 December 2026. It is relaxable up to 05 years for SC/ST, Women and PwBD, and 03 years for OBC (NCL) candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend for the DIAT SRF?
faq.answer: The monthly stipend is 42,000/- + 30% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q6. Are medical facilities provided?
faq.answer: Yes, in addition to the monthly stipend, medical facilities limited to MI Room facilities shall be extended to the incumbent.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring original certificates/testimonials etc. with a set of attested copies of each. Candidates in Government/PSU/Autonomous Bodies must also bring a No Objection Certificate from the present employer.

faq.question: Q8. Is the DIAT SRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The position is temporary for 09 months (OR) co-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier. It does not confer any right for absorption in DIAT, Pune.

faq.question: Q9. Is TA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No TA will be paid for attending the Walk-in-Interview.
